name: ichnaea-workspace
description: Ichnaea: statistically sound evaluation of GenAI applications, offline and online.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings . && node scripts/check-purity.ts && node scripts/check-ai-sdk-boundary.ts && node scripts/check-contract-majors.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:generated
scripts.check:generated: pnpm run generate && git status --porcelain -- packages && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages/*/schemas packages/*/fixtures)"
